name: tiedrank
expr: [r1, t1] = tiedrank(x); [r2, t2] = tiedrank(xa); [r3, t3] = tiedrank(xn); [rm, tm] = tiedrank(M);
comment: MATLAB tiedrank: ranks adjusted for ties via averaging. Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b on vector + matrix forms. Tieadj uses (t^3 - t) / 2 per tied group. Includes all-equal and no-ties edges. NaN handling tested in gtest only (parity harness fingerprint format doesn't preserve NaN trivially).
